libs.note: BH-5913: the per-project lane runner. pl_dispatch starts one detached run per fleet project (bin/project-lane-run.sh), each with its own lock locks/<lane>-<project>.lock. BH-5944 adds pl_lane_lock (the project lock plus the legacy locks/<lane>.lock held SHARED, so a whole-fleet run and a project run never overlap), pl_lane_lock_all, pl_lane_dispatch (the dispatch period from PL_DISPATCH_SPREAD_PCT, resolved through lib_env_apply project-lanes) and pl_agg_lock. docs/notes/2026-10-10-BH-5913-project-lanes.md, docs/notes/2026-10-13-BH-5944-project-loops-runner.md.

knobs.zero_means: every project run of a dispatch starts at once
knobs.note: BH-5944: the share of each lane's dispatch window that pl_lane_dispatch spreads the project runs over (dequeue-watch 50 s, archie-fm 300 s, review-autopilot 1800 s, fleet-status-push 0 s, metrics-collect 600 s, stale-owed-tickets 600 s). Each project starts at a stable offset inside window x PCT / 100. Not a whole number in 0..100 is 100, with one stderr line. Read as ${PL_DISPATCH_SPREAD_PCT:-100}.

BH-5944 test seam, honoured only under HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1: <dir>:<n>. After pl_lane_lock holds both locks it appends `<lane> <project> <pid>` to <dir>/holders and waits (60 s at most) until the file has <n> lines; at the limit it writes `<lane> <project>` to <dir>/timeouts. Empty in prod.

knobs.zero_means: the run goes on past the barrier
knobs.note: BH-5944 test seam, honoured only with PL_TEST_BARRIER under HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1: 1 = the run exits 0 after the barrier, so a suite proves the lock concurrency without the lane body.

knobs.zero_means: a held lock is a time-out at once
knobs.note: BH-5944 test seam, honoured only under HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1: the wait of pl_agg_lock and of archie-fm's day-cap lock (afm_cap_claim). Prod is always 30 s.
